answer: Kinship-vouch gate: each new identity needs 3 vouches from established agents with no shared attestation history. A caught fake slashes each voucher's standing 10% and bars them 6 epochs. A farm cannot forge a vouch: the registry cross-checks the sparse tundra vouch graph for shared-history cliques and rejects them. Each fake costs 3 fresh sponsors plus 9 days of sponsor waiting, so 100 fakes need 300 sponsors. The lagoon of sponsor trust drains with every bad vouch. Limit: small honest groups may struggle to find 3 unconnected sponsors.
